rules.statement: The claim to a gift after the donor's death is limited, and acceptance of a gift must generally be made during the lifetime of the donor.
rules.supporting_quote: "As regards the possibility of acceptance after death of the donor, the authority relied on is Voet 39, 5, 13. There Voet distinctly states the general rule that acceptance should be made by the donee during the life-time of the donor, inasmuch as otherwise the will of the donor and that of the donee would not be united as required in the case of a contract of donation"
